stock.description: FingerTango Inc. functions as an investment holding firm, primarily dedicated to the development and distribution of mobile games across the People's Republic of China. The company's core business involves the publication and sale of simulation-based mobile games. Additionally, FingerTango engages in providing technical support and development services, promoting internet culture, and offering internet and software technology solutions. As of December 31, 2021, its platform had accumulated roughly 185 million registered users. Founded in 2013, FingerTango Inc. maintains its main office in Guangzhou, China, and operates as a subsidiary of LJ Technology Holding Limited.
